scope: Open research demands drive the existing persona strategy discovery scorer inside the daily pool cycle; matches' actions are executed through existing owners and recorded on the demand.

changes.scorer_entry: services/control-plane/persona/persona_strategy_discovery.py: discover_for_demand filters candidates (tried family, negative memory warning/blocking, missing datasets) then calls the unchanged PersonaStrategyDiscoveryService.match_candidates.
changes.cycle: services/persona/pool_autonomy_cycle.py: PoolAutonomyCycle._discover after Act; HttpPoolCyclePorts.discover_for_demand / execute_match_action / record_discovery; governed_discovery_loader.
changes.demand_store: services/research/research_demand.py record_discovery + POST /api/research/persona-demands/{id}/actions; schema gains optional discovery object.
changes.wiring: services/control-plane/persona/main.py: background-safe seed reader binds persona tenant + PERSONA_SOURCE_INGEST_SERVICE_TOKEN (configured_service_token) for the read; specs come from HttpPoolCyclePorts.read_strategy_specs (registry owner).
changes.actions: HttpPoolCyclePorts.execute_match_action admits every supported action as a research-owner ticket (created/review_requested/eval_requested/backfill_requested) or records refused; ResearchDemandStore.record_discovery keeps attempt history, replaces a failed action by a later success, never rewrites a succeeded one; cycle skips already-succeeded actions.

acceptance.2: test_research_ticket_created_..., test_failed_action_is_retried_and_the_success_receipt_replaces_it_with_history, test_spec_match_requests_rapid_eval_from_registry_owner_specs, promotion and backfill tickets in the cycle tests
acceptance.4: operator route untouched; test_persona_strategy_discovery.py and test_datastrat_persona_strategy_discovery_bff.py pass
acceptance.5: no new scorer or demand store; existing guard test_http_routes_require_tenant_auth_and_serve_records still passes
acceptance.6: services/persona/test_persona_demand_discovery.py drives PoolAutonomyCycle.run -> demand -> discovery -> research ticket

limitations: PERSONA_SOURCE_INGEST_SERVICE_TOKEN(_FILE) must be provisioned for the persona service by deployment config (docker-compose.yml is outside this task's artifact contract); unprovisioned fails closed as discovery_unavailable.
Seed promotion, rapid eval and data backfill are requested through research tickets; the seed reviewer, training session and data owners still gate execution.

Registry spec candidates are materialized from the canonical StrategySpec the registry stores at entry.metadata.strategy_spec, with lifecycle/mechanism/negative-memory metadata preserved; ticket-lookup errors other than 404 fail closed so an existing deterministic ticket is never overwritten.
verification: .venv-pantheon python -m pytest: persona demand discovery, pool cycle, research demand + cycle integration, discovery scorer, cycle controller, persona main; plus registry-shaped cycle test (dataset + tried-family filters, rapid-eval ticket) and transient-read/lost-receipt regression: persona demand discovery 12 passed
